extracted.intended_audience: journalists, reporters and editors (Reuters staff and newsrooms)
extracted.subtask_description: A comprehensive handbook of Reuters editorial standards, ethics, style and operational procedures for producing, presenting and correcting news. Covers accuracy, sourcing, independence, corrections, photo/video standards, story forms, headlines, desk procedures, embargoes and more.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standards and Values — Accuracy
rubrics_metrics.description: Section headed 'Accuracy' — rules and expectations for factual correctness in reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standards and Values — Freedom from bias
rubrics_metrics.description: Section headed 'Freedom from bias' — guidance on impartiality and avoiding bias in coverage (e.g., 'Take no side, tell all sides').

rubrics_metrics.name: Standards and Values — Independence
rubrics_metrics.description: Section headed 'Independence' — rules about editorial independence and avoiding conflicts of interest.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standards and Values — Integrity
rubrics_metrics.description: Section headed 'Integrity' — principles governing honest, ethical journalism and behaviour.

rubrics_metrics.name: Corrections — Corrections Procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for correcting stories, including 'When to correct', 'When to refile', 'When to repeat' and related processes (kills/withdrawals).

rubrics_metrics.name: Corrections — Suspect Story / Suspect story requires correction
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on identifying and handling suspect stories that may require correction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Corrections — Kills (Withdrawals) - Procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and procedures for killing or withdrawing stories (including refile procedures and related appendix material).

rubrics_metrics.name: Embargoes — Types of Embargoes
rubrics_metrics.description: Definitions and classification of embargo types and how to handle them.

rubrics_metrics.name: Embargoes — Minimising the risk of an embargo break
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance and best practices to avoid breaking embargoes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Embargoes — Adding Embargoes to Stories
rubrics_metrics.description: How to apply embargoes to stories in systems and tag them correctly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Embargoes — Accidental release to Reuters desktop products
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for dealing with accidental embargo releases to Reuters products.

rubrics_metrics.name: Embargoes — Mending fences on embargo breaks
rubrics_metrics.description: How to repair relationships and handle repercussions after an embargo break.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sourcing
rubrics_metrics.description: Section 'Sourcing' — criteria and guidance on choosing, verifying and using sources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quotes
rubrics_metrics.description: Section 'Quotes' — rules for quoting sources accurately and attributing quotations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reflecting reality
rubrics_metrics.description: Section 'Reflecting reality' — guidance on portraying events and people truthfully and in context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Datelines and bylines
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for datelining stories and assigning bylines (who gets credit and where).

rubrics_metrics.name: Attribution
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on attributing information to sources and the appropriate forms of attribution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reporting rumours
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for handling rumours and unverified claims in reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Graphic images and obscenities
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules about use and publication of graphic images and obscene content; sensitivities and legal considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Take no side, tell all sides
rubrics_metrics.description: Editorial principle to remain neutral and present all relevant sides of a story.

rubrics_metrics.name: Opinion and Analysis
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance distinguishing opinion/analysis from straight reporting and how to label and present such material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Discriminatory language and stereotypes
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards preventing discriminatory language and stereotypical portrayals in coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Investment advice
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules around providing or avoiding investment advice within reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reporting on Reuters
rubrics_metrics.description: Special guidance covering stories about Reuters itself and internal coverage rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Political and Community Activity
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for staff participation in political and community activities and how these affect impartiality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equal Opportunity in the Newsroom
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies ensuring equal opportunity practices within Reuters' newsroom operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Diversity in the Newsroom
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance to foster and reflect diversity among staff and in coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media Interviews and Speaking Engagements
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for staff appearances in other media and public speaking, including what to disclose and avoid.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personal Investments
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards on journalists' personal investments and how they create possible conflicts of interest.

rubrics_metrics.name: Declaring financial interests
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for disclosing relevant financial interests that could affect reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Work outside Reuters
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on outside work (freelance, consulting) and how it affects independence and conflicts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Checking back with sources
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for verifying facts with primary sources before publication when appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Gifts and entertainment
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules on accepting gifts, hospitality and entertainment from sources and subjects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Travel and accommodation
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards on accepting travel/accommodation offers and disclosure of such support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bribes and other inducements
rubrics_metrics.description: Zero-tolerance policies and procedures to handle bribes and improper inducements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Independence Within Reuters
rubrics_metrics.description: Internal boundaries and expectations to safeguard editorial independence inside the organisation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Entering competitions and receiving awards
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies about entering journalism competitions and accepting awards, including disclosure rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Photos — A Brief Guide to Standards, Photoshop and Captions
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for photographic integrity, use of Photoshop, accurate captions and photo staging.

rubrics_metrics.name: Photoshop
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific rules on altering images and the technical/ethical limits of image manipulation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Set-ups / Staging of Pictures
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance forbidding or limiting staged photos and how to label any staged shots.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accuracy in Captions
rubrics_metrics.description: Expectations that photo captions are factual, precise and checked.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sensitive Images in a Controlled Environment
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for photographing sensitive subjects under controlled conditions and how to present them.

rubrics_metrics.name: Photo Opportunities
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on handling orchestrated photo opportunities and ensuring transparency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Caption examples
rubrics_metrics.description: Examples of acceptable and unacceptable captions to guide staff.

rubrics_metrics.name: Video — A Brief Guide to the Standards and Values of Reuters Video News
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards specific to video production, editing and presentation consistent with Reuters values.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cracking the codes — Coding guidelines / Reuters Instrument Codes (RICs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Technical guidance for coding, using Reuters Instrument Codes and checking RICs in stories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Service messages
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and formats for internal/external service messages sent by Reuters systems.

rubrics_metrics.name: News Presentation — Bullet points, Brief, Updates and Wrapups
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on concise news presentation forms: bullet points, briefs, updates and wrapups.

rubrics_metrics.name: Headlines — Make the headline strong / Headline tags
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and techniques for writing effective headlines and using headline tags.

rubrics_metrics.name: Slugs and Slugging
rubrics_metrics.description: Operational rules for story slugs used by desks and systems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bylines
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria for assigning bylines and author credit in different story types.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cross-heads (Sub-heads) and Story Links
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance for sub-heads and linking related stories coherently.

rubrics_metrics.name: Datelines
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for datelining stories, including location conventions and exceptions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedules — Skedlines / Schedule issue times
rubrics_metrics.description: Operational guidance for scheduling story issues and using skedlines for media schedules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sign-offs
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for sign-off lines and ending copy for different wire/story types.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unique Story Numbers (USNs) / The USN drill
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for assigning unique story numbers and the USN process for operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other Common Story Forms (Spot story, Sidebar, Feature, Analysis, Interview, Factbox, Q&A etc.)
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance and criteria for a wide variety of story forms and when to use each form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reporting and Writing Basics — Who do we write for? / Basic story structure
rubrics_metrics.description: Fundamentals of audience, structure and craft for news writing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reporting and Writing Basics — Filing to Desk / Filing your story to the desk
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and expectations for filing copy to the desk (methods, hours, direct injection).

rubrics_metrics.name: Reporting and Writing Basics — Story Length / Make the headline strong / The 10 key words approach
rubrics_metrics.description: Practical rules of thumb for story length, strong headlines and key-word focused writing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reporting and Writing Basics — Some checks for error-free copy / The Attention Editor flag
rubrics_metrics.description: Pre-publication checks, use of attention flags and basic copy proofreading checks.

rubrics_metrics.name: The Drill for Breaking News — The Alert, The Newsbreak, Updates, The Wrapup
rubrics_metrics.description: Operational workflow and content standards for handling breaking news drills and live coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: The Desk — Black hole filing / Desk hours of operation
rubrics_metrics.description: Desk-level rules for filing, black hole filing concerns and desk working hours.

rubrics_metrics.name: The Desk — Direct injection / Filing methods
rubrics_metrics.description: Technical and procedural guidance for directly injecting copy into systems and accepted filing methods.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alerts and Newsbreaks — Newsbreak content
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for what qualifies as an alert or newsbreak and what content to include.

rubrics_metrics.name: Market reports / Factboxes / Chronology / Timelines / Tables
rubrics_metrics.description: Formatting and content guidance for specialized data-driven story elements and reference boxes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Blogs / Diaries / Columns / Opinion labelling
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance for bloggy/columnist formats and how to distinguish them from straight reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Polling coverage — Covering other organisations' polls
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards on reporting polls produced by other organisations and how to present poll results.

rubrics_metrics.name: Guidelines for 'To Recap' and Technical Guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: Miscellaneous technical and recap guidance for specific operational or technical practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Style A–Z (spelling, usage, acronyms, punctuation etc.)
rubrics_metrics.description: Extensive style guidance covering words, spellings, grammar and punctuation (A–Z entries).
